newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate eases 70 bps to 9.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate eases 70 bps to 9.0 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate eased 70 basis points to 9.0 percent on Tuesday in quiet trade, totalling 16.3 million kuna.
New call money loans totalled 9.5 million kuna at 9.0 percent.
The remainder were old one-week funds, rolled over by insurers also at 9.0 percent.

The central bank's kuna midrates for Wednesday firmed to 5.5081 versus 5.5369 against the dollar, while remaining little changed at 3.5626 to the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
